crm_notes:
Lead from inbound signup form (self-serve). CTO (Priya Rao) concerned about prompt retention and ability for users to opt-out of data collection. Wants to know: 
- How long does Hosted API keep request/response logs by default?
- Is there a way to disable logging per-api-key or per-account?
- Do we store full prompts or only hashed/metadata?
- Can we support deletion requests or an automated opt-out for EU customers?
AE summary: introduced Redwood hosted API (self-serve) features. Emphasized default retention policies, opt-out flow, and masking. Priya: "If we send PII in prompts we need assurance it'll be deleted on request and not used for model training."
Notes from call 2026-03-04:
- Priya wants a POC that shows: 1) redaction on client side + 2) server-side opt-out toggle + 3) retention set to 0/disabled for sensitive routes.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, prefers per-token hosted pricing. Will likely move to dedicated only if traffic grows >100k tokens/day.
- Model preference: causal-chat smaller open models for cost; fallback to medium-sized quantized variants acceptable.
- Latency target: p95 < 400ms for short chat (<=150 tokens). Throughput: bursty, not sustained.
- Compliance: SOC2 sufficient for now; asks about data residency options for future EU customers.
Action items recorded by AE: request design doc from SE on available retention controls, generate sample request to disable logging for an API key, share security FAQ and privacy addendum.
